body: Do we need client caching too? Server caching should help when there are few nodes with large number of shards. But if there many nodes that frequently poll stats, networking overhead will cripple up. May be distribute load, client picks random node from cluster and if that node does not have it in cache, forward to master and populate cache.
`TransportGetAllocationStatsAction$Response` is pretty small, ~100B/node or thereabouts, I think caching it on the master is sufficient.

issue.body:
Change use of `NodesStatsRequestParameters.Metric` in code from String to Enum.

I found that we use `NodesStatsRequestParameters.Metric` as string and enum interchangeably in code. Enum is already validated at HTTP request processing and can be safely used later in the code. Use of enum makes code simpler and compiler is happy too.

There are many lines touched but these are type changes. Major changes are:
- `NodesStatsRequest` uses `Metric` `Enum` rather than `String`, hence there are no `IllegalStateException` exceptions converting string to enum
- Encapsulate conversions from/to String/Stream into Metric enum. Before it was a bit scattered.

A little cleanup before getting into #110716
